context_for_next_testing_agent: Security PIN feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/auth/security-pin/check/{uid} returns has_security_pin:true and is_default flag correctly. 2) POST /api/auth/security-pin/change accepts either current_security_pin or login_pin for identity verification. 3) Rejects invalid PINs (not 4 digits, all same digits). 4) verify-security endpoint now takes security_pin instead of security answer. 5) Security PIN is NEVER returned in any API response - FIXED security issue where security_pin_hash was exposed in /api/users/{uid} endpoint. 6) Frontend ForgotPin page shows 5 steps when user has security PIN (Security step appears after Document verification). 7) Security PIN input is masked (type=password) with data-testid='security-pin-input'.
